meta.homeTitle: EcoPlants — Plants that live in Malaysian homes
meta.homeDescription: Live indoor and garden plants delivered across Peninsular Malaysia, chosen for our climate and backed by a {days}-day survival guarantee.

home.heroLead: Every plant we sell is picked for Malaysian conditions — our humidity, our light, our aircon. Tell us your space and we will tell you honestly what will survive in it.
home.spaceLead: The fastest route to a plant that survives is your window, not your mood board.
home.spaceLowBody: No direct window. Snake plants, ZZ, Aglaonema.
home.spaceMediumBody: Near a window, out of the beam. Most houseplants.
home.spacePetsBody: ASPCA non-toxic only. No guesses in this list.
home.collectionLead: Ranked by what survives in real Malaysian homes, not by what photographs well.
home.guaranteeHeading: If it does not make it,
home.guaranteeStep1: Your plant arrives, and you keep it in its nursery pot for the first two weeks.
home.guaranteeStep2: If it fails within {days} days, send us photos of the whole plant and its soil on WhatsApp.
home.guaranteeStep3: We ship a replacement of the same variety and size, free. One per item.
home.quizHeadingAccent: One plant that will not die.
home.quizLead: How much light, how often you will realistically water, whether there is a cat in the house. We shortlist three that fit — and tell you which to avoid.
home.petSafeLead: Checked against the ASPCA non-toxic list. Where we have not verified a plant we say so, instead of guessing — several "safe" classics, lucky bamboo and aloe among them, are not.
home.storyHeading: We only sell what we have
home.storyBody: Every plant in the catalogue has spent a season in a Malaysian home or on a Malaysian balcony before it reaches the shop. If it could not handle our humidity, our afternoon sun or an air-conditioned bedroom, it is not here.
home.storyStat1Label: Survival guarantee on every live plant, replacement not refund.
home.storyStat2Label: Delivery across Peninsular Malaysia, packed to survive the transit heat.
home.storyStat3Label: Pet-safety checked against the ASPCA database, or marked unverified.
home.trustHeading: Why people buy plants from us
home.trust1Body: Photo proof, free replacement, no arguments. One per item.
home.trust2Body: ASPCA-checked, and marked unverified where we have not confirmed it.
home.trust3Body: Heat-safe packaging, and we tell you when a plant cannot survive East Malaysia transit.
home.trust4Body: Send a photo of your space before you buy. We will tell you what will live there.

attributes.lightLowDetail: A dim corner or a room with no direct window. It will still grow, just slowly.
attributes.lightMediumDetail: A few metres from a window, or a bright room without direct sunbeams.
attributes.lightBrightIndirectDetail: Near a bright window, but out of the sunbeam itself. Most houseplants want this.
attributes.lightDirectSunDetail: Six or more hours of unfiltered Malaysian sun. Balcony, porch or garden.
attributes.waterWeeklyDetail: Roughly once a week — check the top 3cm of soil first.
attributes.waterFortnightlyDetail: Every couple of weeks. Err on the dry side.
attributes.waterWhenDryDetail: Wait until the soil is dry all the way through. Overwatering is the usual killer.
attributes.waterKeepMoistDetail: Never let it dry out completely. Damp, not waterlogged.

quiz.q1: How much natural light does the spot get?
quiz.q1Help: Stand where the plant will live and look at the window, not the room.
quiz.q1LowHint: No window in view, or a north-facing one
quiz.q1MediumHint: Bright room, but no direct sunbeam
quiz.q1BrightHint: Near a window, out of the beam
quiz.q2: Honestly — how often will you water it?
quiz.q2Help: The honest answer gets you a plant that survives. The aspirational one does not.
quiz.q2OftenHint: Happy to check every couple of days
quiz.q3: Any cats or dogs in the house?
quiz.q3YesHint: We will only show ASPCA non-toxic plants
quiz.q4: Have you kept a plant alive before?
quiz.q5: How much room does it have?
quiz.q6: Is the space air-conditioned most of the day?
quiz.q6Help: Aircon strips humidity, which is what kills most ferns and calatheas in Malaysian homes.
quiz.q6No: No, it is open to the air
quiz.resultsLead: Ranked on light, watering habit, care level and size — with the caveats spelled out, not hidden.
quiz.noneTitle: Nothing in stock fits all of that
quiz.noneBody: That combination is genuinely hard to match — usually full sun plus pets. Message us and we will tell you what to look for.
quiz.avoidHeading: Skip these with a cat or dog in the house
quiz.avoidBody: All three are common recommendations elsewhere. All three are toxic to pets.
quiz.reasonLightExact: Wants exactly the light you have
quiz.reasonSize: Grows to the size you have room for
quiz.cautionDim: Will grow slowly and stretch in a dim spot
quiz.cautionMoist: Needs consistently damp soil — not a forgiving choice
quiz.cautionOverwater: Easy to overwater if you check on it too often
quiz.cautionDemanding: More demanding than your experience level suggests
quiz.cautionAircon: Aircon will dry this one out — it needs humidity

guarantee.headline: {days}-day survival guarantee
guarantee.summary: If your plant does not make it through its first two weeks, send us a photo and we will replace it. One replacement per item.
guarantee.context: Most Malaysian sellers offer seven days. We offer fourteen, because two weeks is roughly how long it takes a plant to tell you whether it has settled into a new home.
guarantee.step1Title: Keep it in the nursery pot
guarantee.step1Body: For the first two weeks, leave the plant in the pot it arrived in. Repotting during this window stresses the roots and voids the guarantee.
guarantee.step2Body: If it fails within {days} days, message us on WhatsApp with clear photos of the whole plant and its soil. The soil tells us as much as the leaves do.
guarantee.step3Body: We ship a replacement of the same variety and size at no cost. One replacement per item purchased.
guarantee.term1: Report within {days} days of delivery with clear photos of the whole plant and its soil.
guarantee.term2: Replacement, not refund — we send you a new plant of the same variety and size.
guarantee.term4: Repotting within the first {days} days voids the guarantee — the plant needs to settle first.
guarantee.term5: Parcels must be collected within 24 hours of delivery notification.

shipping.freeOver: Free delivery over {amount} in Peninsular Malaysia
shipping.peninsular: Delivered across Peninsular Malaysia in 2–4 working days.
shipping.eastMalaysia: Transit to Sabah and Sarawak takes 7–8 working days, which most live plants will not survive. Plants marked Peninsular-only ship within the Peninsula; accessories and hardy plants ship nationwide.
shipping.sameDay: Same-day delivery in Klang Valley, Penang and Johor Bahru for orders placed before 12pm.
